query: UPDATE factory.ticket_attempts SET stage = $1::SMALLINT, revision = $2, failed_at = CASE WHEN $1::SMALLINT = $3::SMALLINT THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE failed_at END, failure_reason = CASE WHEN $1::SMALLINT = $3::SMALLINT THEN 'hard validation did not pass' ELSE failure_reason END WHERE id = $4
